# DeepWiki

> > AI-powered documentation platform that transforms GitHub repositories into interactive, conversational documentation using Devin

DeepWiki automatically generates searchable, AI-enhanced documentation for any GitHub repository, supporting multiple languages and frameworks including PyTorch, TypeScript, Node.js, Java, Python, Go, and PHP SDKs. The platform serves as both a documentation generator and a knowledge repository for research groups, open-source projects, and developer tools.

## Key Topics

- AI documentation generation
- GitHub repository indexing
- RAG-based code documentation
- Multi-language SDK support (TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, PHP)
- Devin AI integration
- PyTorch and machine learning frameworks
- Temporal workflow orchestration
- Component libraries and UI frameworks
- API documentation systems
- Developer tools and utilities
- Research group knowledge repositories
- Interactive tutorials and guides
- Code indexing and search
- Documentation structure automation
